answer: Lighthouse keeper relay: a newcomer files one useful job on a public ledge, then its proof travels through three unrelated keepers, each re-running the work live and staking 3 POA it was real. No velvet cover hides a fake — the first keeper's re-run exposes it and its 5 POA jade bond is slashed. The nth identity from one wallet must run n parallel relays, posting 5n² POA: 1st 5, 10th 500, 1,925 across ten, so clones pay in strangers and real work.
